name: Insert Coin: The Console Wars
description: Fifty years of living-room rivalry, from Pong to the PlayStation 5: the machines, the mascots, the crash that nearly ended it all, and the companies that won and lost.

checkpoints.name: Arcade to Atari
checkpoints.note: Pong brings video games to bars and then to living rooms. The Atari 2600 sells in millions, and rivals such as Mattel and Coleco race to catch up in a market that seems to have no limit.

checkpoints.name: Crash and comeback
checkpoints.note: Too many consoles and poor games bring the American market down. Nintendo returns it to life with the NES and Super Mario Bros., and Sega starts to challenge it with the Master System and Genesis.

checkpoints.name: The 16-bit rivalry
checkpoints.note: Sega and Nintendo trade blows with Sonic and Mario, in adverts that name their rival. Newcomers such as the 3DO and Jaguar try to join and fail, and Sony prepares a console of its own.

checkpoints.name: Into three dimensions
checkpoints.note: The PlayStation and Nintendo 64 bring 3D worlds into homes. Sega leaves hardware after the Dreamcast, Microsoft enters with the Xbox, and the PlayStation 2 becomes the best-selling console ever.

checkpoints.name: Online and motion
checkpoints.note: The Wii invites everyone to play, while Xbox and PlayStation compete on power and online services. The Switch mixes handheld and home play and sells in huge numbers, and the contest continues.
